summary: Section 8 of the current PO (dated 23.04.2025, eCampus labels it 2024): compulsory BWL and Wirtschaftsinformatik modules (24 ECTS), 12 ECTS computer science electives, 12 ECTS further foundations, 24 ECTS from one master profile (CIDA, DITraM or UCeDI), a 12-ECTS project seminar, 6 ECTS additive key competencies and the 30-ECTS thesis.

categories.name: Computer science electives
categories.note: 12 ECTS from the computer science electives (Informatik - Wahlpflicht).

categories.name: Further foundations electives
categories.note: 12 ECTS from the further foundations electives (Weitere Grundlagen - Wahlpflicht). Catalogue modules are 3, 6 or 8 ECTS, so the number of modules follows the credit total.

categories.name: One master profile

options.id: Wahlmodule > Computational Intelligence and Data Analytics (CIDA)
Wahlmodule > Digital Innovation and Transformation Management (DITraM)
Wahlmodule > User Centered Design of Digital Innovations (UCeDI)

categories.note: 24 ECTS in one master profile (CIDA, DITraM or UCeDI). Modules of 3 or 4 ECTS can mean more than four modules are needed, and the profile is fixed by the first module credited only to that specialisation (a change needs the examination board).
